description: This file defines the ReadableOrderProductDownload class, an entity representing downloadable product details within an order, including properties like product name, download URL, filename, expiry days, and download count, extending a base Entity and implementing Serializable.

classes.name: ReadableOrderProductDownload
classes.description: Represents downloadable product information associated with an order, including identification, URL, filename, expiry, and download count.

methods.name: getDownloadExpiryDays
methods.description: Returns the number of days until the download expires.

methods.name: setDownloadExpiryDays
methods.description: Sets the number of days until the download expires.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename associated with the download.

methods.name: setFileName
methods.description: Sets the filename for the download.
